intent: Read each staggered lightning lane from a roofed pocket, hop the bramble cuts between strikes, and cross only while the lane is dark. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The first thunder lane
sections.lesson: Amber warns · white lightning hurts · cross when dark. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.
